labs.location: 62 Summer St, Boston, MA 02110 (offices across New England)
labs.research_summary: Environmental advocacy and law organization working on climate, ocean, clean air and water, and community issues across New England.
labs.join_notes: Page describes staff and paid internship openings (mostly for law students, plus summer slots for undergraduates and non-legal graduate students) and points to a list of openings; no contact address given on the page.
labs.notes: Large organization: team page lists about 246 staff (many attorneys) by state, so no count. Press contact Mike Naughton, 617.850.1709, press@clf.org. Team page also mentions a separate list of volunteer Senior Fellows (not read).
